title: Scoreboard: web + native iOS
lede: An end-to-end pass through presentation, navigation, counting, API contracts, and recovery. Changes are local and uncommitted.

sections.heading: Web layout and history
sections.note: Same existing isolated Preview dataset, authenticated hidden Admin, route, viewport, appearance and fixed capture clock. Synthetic names are expected. Source manifests and hash-bound receipts are retained.

pairs.title: Desktop hierarchy
pairs.beforeCap: The record and leaderboard cards touch.
pairs.afterCap: Clear separation and readable table headings.

pairs.title: Tablet layout
pairs.beforeCap: The desktop ranking grid truncates names; the shared header pushes notifications off screen.
pairs.afterCap: Stacked person rows preserve names, and the header fits the viewport.

pairs.title: Personal work history
pairs.beforeCap: The total says one event worked, but the history is empty.
pairs.afterCap: The completed event is visible, even without an official result. The record remains 0–0.

sections.heading: Native season overview
sections.note: Same iPhone 18 Pro Max on iOS 27.0, original 27-game fixture, light appearance, default text, top scroll position. Optional-field fallback is intentionally exercised. These captures prove simulator presentation, not authenticated production data.

pairs.title: Overview and controls
pairs.beforeCap: The leading sport is called Most worked despite measuring official games; the venue is truncated.
pairs.afterCap: Most games states the measure accurately, the venue wraps, and an explicit neutral refresh action is available.

sections.heading: Context and recovery · after-only
sections.note: These exact workflow states do not have a trustworthy matching baseline. Web failures use controlled HTTP responses over an authenticated local session; native states use the isolated fixture API.

shots.title: Web team retry
shots.cap: The requested opponent stays selected while the previous All events scope remains explicit. Retry applies the requested filter.

shots.title: Web person retry
shots.cap: The last successful history stays visible after a failed Away read. Retry and Clear filters both recover.

shots.title: Native person context
shots.cap: The person’s name, Football, Camp Randall Stadium, Iowa and Home carry over from the team view.

shots.title: Native failed refresh
shots.cap: Away remains selected. The prior 14–12–1 record remains visible with an explicit notice; the XCTest then retries and verifies the Away result.

changes.was: Individual reads dropped venue/opponent; native navigation also dropped the selected team stack.
changes.now: All four dimensions carry into the person view. Stable season facets and Clear filters keep the explorer switchable.

changes.h: Records and history have distinct rules
changes.was: Result-less work could disappear, raw-title NULL comparisons could omit manual official games, and page-sized history truncated streaks.
changes.now: Two bounded scalar reads separate completed work from official results. Full-season recent results/streaks are computed before paging; exclusions, ties and count-once participation remain server-owned.

changes.was: Failed filter changes could reset controls or hide why old numbers remained.
changes.now: Both clients retain the last loaded scope, keep requested controls selected, and explain Retry. Obsolete pages are rejected; duplicate IDs merge once.

changes.was: All-day dates could fall into the prior local day, and invalid cursors could repeat page one.
changes.now: Calendar-day labels are stable, non-advancing cursors stop paging, names accompany person navigation, and team search retains rank.

verification: 123 focused web/API/source-contract tests passed across 13 files.

3 Scoreboard checks passed against disposable local PostgreSQL, alongside 8 existing custody checks. Covers actual SQL NULL semantics, exclusions, hidden identities, canonical filtering, paging and team/profile/person agreement.
17 native model tests and 3 native UI workflows passed on the required iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator. Xcode builds passed for Wisconsin and WisconsinPerformance.

Authenticated Preview checks passed for navigation, filtered work counts, validation, stale-data retry, clearing, search, and tablet/phone overflow. Controlled HTTP fixtures verified failed pagination, deduplication and terminal cursors; browser page errors: 0.
TypeScript, changed-file lint, app-only production build, docs verification and diff checks passed. No schema changes or migrations were run against a shared database.
Repository-wide lint remains blocked by the existing no-assign-module-variable error in public/qrcode/vendor/jsQR.js; changed files are clean. Existing unrelated lint warnings remain.
notes: The after-only gallery has no matching baseline for its exact workflow states; it is not a before/after comparison.
No ESPN integration exists or was added. Results still come from Wisconsin calendar markers; work participation comes from Schedule assignments and recorded workers.
No commit, push, deployment or distribution was performed. Production Student/Collaborator reads, authenticated native totals and regular-width iPad acceptance remain GAP-71.
